channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: About 1,300 trucks cross daily as Afghanistan-Iran trade remains steady
item.description: The transit and movement of commercial goods between Afghanistan and Iran are continuing as normal, despite the ongoing conflict in the neighbouring country, with up to 1,300 cargo trucks crossing through the Islam Qala border in western Herat province each day.

item.title: US democracy effort in Afghanistan unsuccessful, says Hegseth
item.description: US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has said efforts by the United States to transform Afghan society into a Western-style democracy were unlikely to succeed from the outset.

item.title: 42 dead in Kenya floods after heavy rains
item.description: At least 42 people have been killed as a result of heavy flash floods in Kenya, a media report said on Monday.

item.title: 14 migrants dead after boat collides with Turkish vessel
item.description: At least 14 Afghan migrants have died after a boat carrying them collided with a Turkish coastguard vessel off the Mediterranean coast, according to reports. Several others were rescued.

item.title: Putin, Trump discuss Iran, Ukraine, Venezuela in phone call
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has held a telephone conversation with his US counterpart Donald Trump, TASS reported.

item.title: Afghan Taekwondo star Mansouri wins gold at 2026 Open G2 in US
item.description: Afghan taekwondo athlete Farzad Mansouri has won a gold medal at the 2026 Open G2 World Taekwondo competitions in the United States after defeating four opponents.

item.title: Trump says war with Iran may end ‘very soon’; Iran responds
item.description: US President Donald Trump has said the war with Iran will end “very soon”.

item.title: Afghanistan-Sri Lanka white-ball series in UAE postponed
item.description: The white-ball cricket series between Afghanistan and Sri Lanka, scheduled for March in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), has been postponed.

item.title: Iran’s FM Araghchi rules out negotiations with US
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has stated that talks with the United States may no longer be on the agenda following a US‑Israeli military operation against the Islamic Republic.
